question: Should plugin approval cancellation be accepted as a public plugin.approval.cancel RPC plus nullable PluginApprovalResolved.decision, and must that contract cover every abort-aware plugin approval waiter before merge?
rationale: The PR changes a plugin SDK-visible approval event contract and leaves sibling abort-aware requesters out of scope, so automation should not choose the permanent API boundary or acceptable rollout scope alone.

options.title: Complete the public cancel contract
options.body: Require all abort-aware plugin approval waiters to use the cancel RPC and make nullable resolved decisions an explicitly covered SDK/channel contract before merge.

options.title: Accept a narrower bug fix
options.body: Allow this PR to fix only before_tool_call and keep Codex app-server/native-hook cancellation as separate tracked work.

options.title: Choose a different contract
options.body: Reject nullable resolved decisions for plugin consumers and ask for a different cleanup shape that preserves the existing SDK decision type.

recommendation.title: Complete the public cancel contract
recommendation.body: Require all abort-aware plugin approval waiters to use the cancel RPC and make nullable resolved decisions an explicitly covered SDK/channel contract before merge.

likelyOwner.reason: The plugin approval gateway and before_tool_call approval behavior traces back to the feature commit by this owner candidate.
